SELECT COALESCE((X.DEPOSITOS - X.RETIROS),0.0) AS SALDO FROM ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN TP.OPERACION = '+' THEN COALESCE(TR.MONTO,0.0) ELSE 0.0 END) AS DEPOSITOS, SUM(CASE WHEN TP.OPERACION = '-' THEN COALESCE(TR.MONTO,0.0) ELSE 0.0 END) AS RETIROS FROM AHORRO.AHTRANSACCIONES_CUENTAS TR LEFT JOIN AHORRO.AHTIPOS_TRANSACCIONES TP ON TP.ID = TR.TIPO_TRANSACCION_ID WHERE TR.CUENTA_ID = ? ) AS X

SELECT (X.DEPOSITOS - X.RETIROS) AS SALDO_FECHA FROM ( SELECT SUM( CASE WHEN TT.OPERACION = '+' THEN COALESCE(TC.MONTO,0.00) ELSE 0.00 END ) AS DEPOSITOS, SUM( CASE WHEN TT.OPERACION = '-' THEN COALESCE(TC.MONTO,0.00) ELSE 0.00 END ) AS RETIROS FROM AHORRO.AHTRANSACCIONES_CUENTAS TC LEFT JOIN AHORRO.AHCUENTAS AC ON AC.ID = TC.CUENTA_ID LEFT JOIN AHORRO.AHTIPOS_TRANSACCIONES TT ON TT.CLAVE = TC.TIPO_CLAVE WHERE TRUE AND AC.ID = ? AND TC.ESTATUS_ID = (SELECT ID FROM NUCLEOCENTRAL.NCESTATUS WHERE DESCRIPCION = 'ALTA') AND TT.OPERACION IN ('+','-') AND CAST(TC.FECHA AS DATE) <= CAST(? AS DATE) ) AS X
